reviews.review:
As much as I would like to recommend this game, I just can't. I am only writing this review in the hopes that the devs see this as I would really like to see this game improve. In it's current state, it feels more like a demo than an actual game. That is because at some point after a lengthy play time, routes get nonsensical no matter what game mode you play. Two of the largest issues I see that make the mid game and beyond almost completely unplayable would be simply fixed by adding a priority system for the passengers. As of right now it appears to be based entirely on distance, but even then it's not solely on distance which leads to a very frustrating experience when trying to set up an optimized network that makes sense so that you can follow a strategy as you build up.

1. The competition AI can simply establish a bus route thousands of miles away and that will cause passengers in your hubs to build up. They won't use your routes to get to closer cities, like you would think if it was solely based on distance. This can lead you to either purchase hundreds of busses for each city in your domain, or you have to get the biggest and most expensive planes for EACH city. This completely breaks down the nature of transportation networks and the use of hubs to make an efficient system. Instead it eventually breaks down to where you have to establish a point to point direct route for EACH city which makes absolutely no practical sense.

2. Passengers will still choose unoptimal routes themselves. In my latest plane only discovery mode game, routes that were previously established in which were working just as intended later became unused for less optimal routes. For example, I was trying to make Baghdad a central hub as that was my starting city and Basra as a collector hub where close iraqi and iranian cities would feed into. However, at some point passengers stopped using this hub to hub connection. So passengers coming from Basra and using Baghdad as a hub to connect to, say, Ankara, stopped using my Basra to Baghdad and instead  go through a city that was in between them. So I had hundreds of passengers line up and wait for this intermediary route that would still take them to Baghdad as I was having planes from Basra to Baghdad run empty. They instead chose the longer and slower route. It makes absolutely no logical sense. And that is not the only route like that, and the illogical priority system worsens as the game advances into a complete ♥♥♥♥ show.

Imagine managing a grocery store and you have 5 registers open. Now imagine seeing 40 customers line up for one register, and the line just keeps growing and growing when the customers just refuse to use the available capacity. This is an extremely fun and addictive game, but it feels like you are restricted to only early game. So I recommend you just play the demo and have fun with that until the dev is able to tweak the algorithm for passenger priority. Pls dev.
